label: Baseline, positive, and release
description: Identity baseline plus positive affect, social warmth, surprise, release, hope, and pride.

styles.label: Neutral
styles.target_text: The envelope rested beside the lamp, exactly where she had left it.
styles.acted_reference_text: The notebook remained open on the desk while the rain tapped against the glass.
styles.instruction: Speak naturally and neutrally, with clear diction, stable identity, and restrained expression.

styles.label: Happy
styles.target_text: The doors opened at last, and everyone inside broke into delighted cheers.
styles.acted_reference_text: She read the message twice, smiling more brightly each time.
styles.instruction: Speak with genuine warm happiness. Make the smile clearly audible without becoming manic or childish.

styles.label: Excited
styles.target_text: They found it—the missing map was hidden inside the frame all along!
styles.acted_reference_text: The results arrived early, and every number was better than they had hoped.
styles.instruction: Speak with unmistakable excitement, quickened momentum, animated emphasis, and delighted anticipation.

styles.label: Friendly
styles.target_text: Come in, make yourself comfortable, and tell me how the journey went.
styles.acted_reference_text: There is fresh coffee in the kitchen if you would like some.
styles.instruction: Speak warmly and invitingly, as though welcoming a trusted friend. Sound relaxed, open, and sincere.

styles.label: Surprised
styles.target_text: The empty chair turned toward her and calmly said her name.
styles.acted_reference_text: When the wall slid aside, there was another room behind it.
styles.instruction: Speak with sudden, unmistakable surprise and disbelief, including an involuntary lift or startled pause.

styles.label: Relief
styles.target_text: The signal returned at last, and everyone in the room began to breathe again.
styles.acted_reference_text: The footsteps passed the hiding place and faded down the corridor.
styles.instruction: Speak with clear relief after prolonged tension. Let the breath release and the voice soften and brighten.

styles.label: Hopeful
styles.target_text: There is still a path through this, and tomorrow we can begin again.
styles.acted_reference_text: A thin line of sunlight appeared beneath the door before morning.
styles.instruction: Speak with cautious but genuine hope, gathering warmth and possibility without sounding certain or triumphant.

styles.label: Proud
styles.target_text: You held your ground, protected the team, and earned every word of this praise.
styles.acted_reference_text: He looked over the finished bridge and allowed himself one quiet smile.
styles.instruction: Speak with grounded pride and earned satisfaction, confident and warm without arrogance or boasting.
